email.stay-imported.description: New stay imported without guest email — invite to complete
email.sync-failed.description: iCal feed read failure, one or more feeds (one email per sync) — new stays not imported
host.alert.message: The format decides how the .ics file is read (reservations vs blocks). The platform says who sold the stay — a Google calendar is a mirror, not a seller. Never share these links publicly.
host.alert.title: Calendar format and platform
host.calendar.active.help: Turn off to pause the import without losing the link.
host.calendar.channel.help: Who sells these stays. The calendar format is deduced from it automatically (and refined from the feed URL). Leave « I don't know » if unsure — Portaki reads the platform from the feed when it is there.
host.calendar.label: Label (optional)
host.calendar.url.unreachable: This link does not return a valid .ics calendar.
host.calendars.emptyDescription: Add an .ics export URL and choose its platform.
host.calendars.hint: Each row is one feed. Format + URL are required. Empty URLs are ignored on save.
host.calendars.label: Calendars
host.channel.abritel-vrbo.help: Stays sold on Abritel, Vrbo, or HomeAway.
host.channel.direct.help: Sold by you — own site, phone, repeat guest.
host.channel.other-platform.help: A platform with no dedicated code: channel manager, agency, regional site.
host.channel.unknown.help: Portaki detects the platform from the feed when it can; otherwise the stay stays unattributed.
host.format.abritel_vrbo.help: Abritel or Vrbo .ics export. Blocks (« Not available », « Blocked ») are skipped.
host.format.airbnb.help: Airbnb → Calendar → Availability → Export. « Reserved » becomes a stay; « Not available » / blocks are skipped.
host.format.booking.help: Booking → Calendar → Sync → Export. « CLOSED - Not available » rows are skipped.
host.format.generic.help: Any other .ics export. Standard VEVENT import; obvious blocks are filtered.
host.format.google.help: Google secret iCal link. Dated events are imported; « Blocked » / « Not available » labels are skipped.
host.main.help: Save format + links, then use Sync feeds. Imported stays show up under Stays.
host.section.feeds.help: Add as many calendar links (.ics) as you need. Pick the format, then the platform if it differs.
host.section.status.help: Updated after Sync feeds or the scheduled job.
host.stay.notImported: Stay not imported from a calendar.
